notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Robin enters the "Concerto" state and all allies actions are advanced by 100% when using her ultimate. While she is in this state, allies receive an attack buff, and she deals additional damage when an ally attacks an enemy.

✦ She gains energy when allies attack through her talent. She also buffs the CRIT DMG of ally Follow-Up Attacks.

**Investment Priority**

**E2 > E1 > S1**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ E2 Helps with "Concerto" uptime and makes speed requirements more comfortable for other teammates.

✦ E1 gives her an extra utility that makes her worth using in some teams. E1 is her baseline investment in endgame scenarios.

✦ S1 helps with ultimate uptime, helps with build flexibility and provides an extra damage boost to the team.
